$comment: Classification for scripts/boundaries.mjs (docs/design/core-slimming §6). role: core = the kernel every host gets; module = an adapter the kernel reaches only through protocol interfaces; test = test support, never imported by production code; example = may import anything. `may` lists the workspace packages (by directory) a package's src may import. `bundle` names the files of a core package allowed to import modules: the composition root that registers the built-in modules.

vendor.$comment: Names that mean a core file knows a concrete module: identifiers containing these words (case-insensitive) in code, and string literals equal to a module id (not `mail`: it is also a conversation kind).
